# P7: context features vs the retained boosting (generated by src/eval_ctx.py)

Alert p1 >= 0.5; confirmed = `confirm.confirm_alerts` defaults (3 lying windows within 3 s). URFD = out-of-fold (5 folds by sequence); GMDCSA-24 and Le2i = final models trained on all URFD, never tuned on them. FA = false alerts in ADL clips (raw count), with the number of ADL clips concerned in brackets.

## 4. Leak check: empty look-back at the start of URFD sequences
